notes: What's New entries, newest first. Only list features that are released and working.

items.title: AVEN 2.0
items.body: Our new main model. On this computer it runs Qwen3.5 9B, a newer and stronger generation than the model behind AVEN 1.1. It replaces AVEN 1.1; conversations with older models keep their names.

items.title: AVEN Light 1.1 and AVEN Core 1.1
items.body: Both move to the newer Qwen3.5 generation (2B in 8-bit precision for Light, 4B for Core). The new models are a one-time download.

items.title: Five categories
items.body: AVEN AI, AVEN Python, AVEN Unity, AVEN CODE and Made With AVEN, each with its own instructions, conversations and remembered model. Switch from the sidebar or with Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+5.

items.title: AVEN Python (free)
items.body: A Python specialist for programs, projects, debugging and refactoring. Attach files or a whole project folder, and save the files from a reply into a folder. Code in replies is checked for syntax errors and undefined names (it is not run).

items.title: AVEN Unity (free)
items.body: A Unity specialist for C# gameplay, controllers, UI and physics. C# in replies is checked for syntax errors and common Unity mistakes, such as a class name that does not match its file or GetComponent called every frame.

items.title: AVEN CODE (subscription)
items.body: The professional multi-language coding category, with project files, architecture plans, reviews and per-language syntax checks. It needs a subscription managed through the AVEN AI server and Stripe; it becomes available once the server is connected to this build.

items.title: Made With AVEN (preview)
items.body: Describe a game and AVEN designs it, writes it, checks it in a sandbox, repairs problems and lets you play it in your browser. Games are 2D for now. Save projects, request changes, and export a .zip. Free while in preview.

items.title: Also new
items.body: This What's New page, a refreshed sidebar with Free, Paid and Preview badges, and your existing conversations and settings carried over unchanged.

items.title: Answer quality
items.body: Instructions per model, cleaner Hebrew (no stray characters from other languages), right-to-left fixes and honest answers about what AVEN cannot check.
